rows.en: You're not getting away! Now go down!
Wahahahaha!! Can't move, can you!? This is our Hambrabi Squad's "Spider Web" tactic!!
After that much damage, they won't be moving! Haul 'em in!
Kh... Not here... not like this...
Zeta Gundam!! Methuss!! Has the current left you unable to move!?
Looks like some fresh prey just showed up, huh?
Hambrabi!! What are you planning to do with those two!?
We'll take your heads too while we're at it!! The more gifts we bring back, the better!!
Kh... I'm not about to die over something like this. If it's come to this... I've got no choice...
I'm taking this one, at least!!
Ah-ah, stay right there. Or else I can't say what'll happen to Methuss.
So that's how you people fight!?
I can't wait! I have to get Methuss...!!
You can't, not in that condition!
Besides, going off alone is dangerous. Calm down, Zeta.
Everyone here is a comrade. Don't you think joining forces is the smart move right now?
You can change your party lineup at the base.
Damn it! Looks like even the great me is losing my edge...
Hambrabi!! What a sorry state you're in!!
That "Sea Snake" you gave me... Now that was one fine weapon...
Hambrabi... Understood... Leave the rest to me!!
I believe I ordered you to capture Zeta and Methuss as a set, did I not?
Silence!! As punishment, you will become Bogal's food!
Fufufu... Spider Man. What a tasty-looking kaijin you are.
At this very moment, Twin Tail is being skewered all over by countless fangs...
...while digestive acid slowly melts its body away, starting from the extremities!
Oh, I do like that expression. It seems even mobile suits can feel fear.
Heh heh heh heh...!! At last I've found one... someone with excessive compatibility!
That's enough, Weather Dopant! Stealing the wind and taking our friend... that's a heavy sin!
That's far enough! I will never forgive a scumbag like you!!
You people again...? I'm impressed you made it all the way here.
However... I cannot forgive you for getting in my way!!
Heh heh heh heh!! Rampage to your hearts' content!
...This wind is incredible. We can't get anywhere near them like this!!
...This wind is incredible. We can't get anywhere near them like this!!

notes.note: proofread: speaker confirmed from 0111.bla: the script plays 0.1-0.21, battle vs Hambrabi, 0.42-0.46, battle vs Spider Man, then 0.22 onward. This is the beaten Spider Man; label correct, English unchanged.
Zeta's line trails off in the source (literally 'I, Methuss...'). The verb 'get' was supplied and the line still ends unfinished.
Nu Gundam is answering Zeta's 'if you'll have me', so he is accepting Zeta into the group: 'Of course we will.'
System message. 'base' is the hub term used in story_002 (check it against the UI name for the hub).
The idiom means losing one's edge or touch. The arrogant first-person 'ore-sama' is rendered as 'even the great me'.
'Sea Snake' is the established English name of Hambrabi's wire weapon (Zeta Gundam), kept in quotes as in the source.

proofread: 0112.bla never plays 0.1-0.5, 0.11-0.15, 0.17-0.19 or 0.21 (unused cut lines, an older draft where Spider Man is fed to Bogal). Their speakers are inferred only: 0.1/0.3 Spider Man, 0.2/0.4 Weather Dopant, 0.5 Bogal. English left as is.

proofread: label confirmed. The played scene opens with 0.90-0.102 (Weather offers Twin Tail to Bogal as a feast), then 0.6-0.10, 0.16, 0.20, 0.22+. Twin Tail is the victim; the Spider Man lines are unused (see 0.1).
proofread: unused line (not called by 0112.bla). The played scene feeds Twin Tail to Bogal, so 'Twin Tail' stays; no change to Spider Man needed. 0.15 uses 'its' for Twin Tail (g=n).

Unused line (not called by 0112.bla). Unlabelled. Weather Dopant (polite sadistic speech) forcing the captive Methuss to watch. 0.12 '...!!' and 0.19 are probably Methuss. 0.17 'Mm... Gnngh...' is unclear: either the victim's last gasp or Methuss being restrained. It is written as a neutral groan.
proofread: Seagorath roar aligned with story_005/006 ('Grooooooh!!'), per the glossary roar-consistency rule. Same for 0.36.
Sound effects in corner brackets are rendered in double quotes, as in story_003. Same for 0.18.

Unlabelled; this is Weather Dopant. The W term 'kajou tekigousha' (someone with excessive Gaia Memory compatibility, what Isaka hunts for in the show) is rendered descriptively as 'someone with excessive compatibility'. I couldn't verify an established English fandom term for it (possibly 'Excessive Adaptor'); worth a glossary entry.
The source says 'MS', rendered as 'mobile suits' following the glossary.
0.22-0.26 and 0.37-0.38 are party-dependent variants: one line per hero, only the ones in the party play.

'Our friend' = Methuss (the source says 'nakama', comrade). 'kidnapped' became 'taking' and 'That's far enough' became 'That's enough' so the line fits in 2 lines; the meaning is unchanged. 'Heavy sin' echoes W's sin motif.

report: PROOFREAD: 80/80 rows checked, 2 changed (Seagorath roar 0.32/0.36 aligned with later slices). Speakers verified against 0111.bla/0112.bla; the Twin Tail vs Spider Man question is settled: the Spider Man feeding lines (0112 0.1-0.5, 0.11-0.15, 0.17-0.19, 0.21) are never played, Twin Tail is the real victim. ORIGINAL: 80/80 rows examined. Key issue: in 0112 #0.14 the source names Twin Tail as Bogal's victim, but the lines before it (0.4-0.5) make Spider Man the victim, and the victim's speaker labels say Twin Tail. Translated as written; needs a decision. Other inferences: 0111 #0.22 could be Spider Man or Hambrabi; 0112 #0.1-0.5, 0.11-0.21 speakers unlabelled and inferred. Terms not in glossary: 'Sea Snake' (Hambrabi's weapon), 'Spider Web' tactic, 'Hambrabi Squad', 'excessive compatibility' (W term, unverified English), 'kaijin'.
